prompts.tell: Create exactly three sequential anticipation frames for the existing side-view Echo Guardian cyber-feline boss. Preserve its gunmetal armor, brass trim, violet cat-eye core, proportions and crisp pixel-art rendering. Arrange exactly three equal cells on a flat #00ff00 chroma-key background with identical scale, ground baseline and anchor: lower shoulders and fix the gaze on a landing point; coil deeper while the violet core brightens; reach maximum compact tension with restrained violet echo arcs. This is a pounce tell only: no jump, strike, slash, projectile, landing impact, text, watermark or frame border.
prompts.active: Create exactly three sequential landing frames for the same side-view Echo Guardian cyber-feline boss, preserving its gunmetal armor, brass trim, violet cat-eye core, proportions and crisp pixel-art rendering. Arrange exactly three equal cells on a flat #00ff00 chroma-key background with identical scale, ground baseline and anchor: compact descending airborne pose; all-four-paw landing impact with a tight violet echo pulse; low stable rebound after impact. Face left in every cell. No forward slash, projectile, long travel streak, text, watermark or frame border.

processing.alpha_method: Border-derived chroma key, transparent matte and despill.
processing.tell_normalization: Each equal cell was point-resized to a 150x150 working image and composited on a transparent 160x128 canvas with one shared floor baseline and anchor.
processing.active_normalization: Each equal cell was point-resized to a 145x145 working image and composited on a transparent 160x128 canvas with one shared landing center and floor baseline.
processing.recovery_derivation: The three authored tell frames were exported in reverse order as a rise-to-stand recovery sequence.

constraints.gameplay_role: Boss2 fixed-location secondary attack startup, landing and recovery
